fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld, articleBody pulled directly from the page's ld+json NewsArticle block) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-html-listing, scraped from the Breaking News category listing page since no working RSS feed or XML sitemap exists) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-html-listing).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

articleId.title: Article ID
articleId.description: Internal numeric Daily Mirror article ID, taken from the trailing digits of the article URL.

categoryId.title: Category ID
categoryId.description: Internal numeric Daily Mirror category/section ID from the URL (e.g. 108 = Breaking News).

category.title: Category
category.description: URL path segment identifying the section (e.g. "breaking-news", "sports", "business", "school_rugby") -- derived from the URL since ld+json's articleSection field is always the static string "Sri Lanka" on every article.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json node (HTML entities decoded).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary, from the NewsArticle ld+json node (HTML entities decoded).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, taken directly from the ld+json NewsArticle node's articleBody field (HTML entities decoded). Article mode only.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name from the ld+json author object -- a specific reporter name on some pieces, or the generic literal "DM Editorial" on many others.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object (url/width/height) from ld+json, passed through as-is. "url" is sometimes the literal string "none" (no lead image) or a relative path rather than an absolute URL. Article mode only.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode listing item, from the visible anchor text on the Breaking News category listing page.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the Breaking News category listing page -- latest mode only.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
